channel.title: Healthy Solutions for Children and Families blog
channel.description: Articles on anxiety, parenting, adolescence, relationships, attention and well-being from the Healthy Solutions for Children and Families team in Doral, FL.

item.title: Signs of Anxiety in Children and How Parents Can Help
item.description: How to tell everyday worry from an anxiety disorder in children, which treatments research supports, and practical ways parents can help at home.

item.title: Beyond the Body: Why Prioritizing Mental Health Matters
item.description: Why mental health deserves the same care as physical health, how stigma keeps people from seeking help, and common myths about therapy.

item.title: How to Manage Anxiety Attacks
item.description: The common signs of an anxiety attack and practical steps to calm one, from slowing your breathing to grounding your senses, plus when to get help.

item.title: Why a Psychology Professional Matters
item.description: Why seeing a psychologist is as ordinary as seeing any other health professional, and what a psychologist does in therapy to help people change.

item.title: Teen Groups!
item.description: A small therapy group for 3 to 5 teens focused on self-esteem, anxiety, depression and relationships, in a safe space where teens can connect.

item.title: Staying Healthy Is Up to You!
item.description: Everyday habits that support both body and mind, from a positive outlook and gratitude to social connection, exercise, sleep and good nutrition.

item.title: Mind-Body Health
item.description: An introduction to psychoneuroimmunoendocrinology, the field that studies the mind and body as one unit, and to how stress can affect the body's defenses.

item.title: Attention and Focus
item.description: Attention is the step before memory. Learn what can reduce it and get practical tips, from fewer distractions to breaks and sleep hygiene, to focus better.

item.title: What Is Memory?
item.description: Memory lets us keep and recall facts, ideas and experiences. Here are simple everyday habits, like good sleep, less stress and exercise, that support it.

item.title: What Is Cogmed?
item.description: Cogmed is an online working memory training program that aims to improve attention, school and work performance. See how it works and how long it lasts.

item.title: How to Help Your Child Cope With Their Parents' Separation
item.description: Children can feel many mixed emotions when their parents separate. These simple tips can help you support your child through separation or divorce.

item.title: Well-Being in the Family
item.description: Why family matters and four simple areas to work on at home: nutrition, movement, time outdoors with less screen time, and quality time together.

item.title: Play Therapy Training with Lisa Saldana (2021)
item.description: In June and July 2021, therapist Lisa Saldana gave a play therapy training series at HSCF for our team of therapists and the community.

item.title: Effective or Assertive Communication
item.description: What assertive communication means for a couple and five practical tips, from choosing the right moment to talk to sharing your emotions honestly.

item.title: How Can I Improve My Mental Health?
item.description: Why mental health matters and everyday ways to care for it, from gratitude, sleep and exercise to connection, meditation and relaxation techniques.

item.title: Balance and Harmony: Coping with COVID-19 After the Vaccine
item.description: A look at how COVID-19 affected emotional health, what early studies reported about fear, anxiety and depression, and the kinds of support that build resilience.
